title: Halation that real photos actually reach
body: Halation is the warm glow film gets around bright things, from light bouncing back through the emulsion. My first version only switched on above a threshold real photos almost never reached, so it did nothing. The fix on 14 September let it bloom at every dynamic range, at a level ordinary highlights reach. A later gain fix made it stronger, and on 23 September every look's halation was halved to match.

images.alt: Two crops of a night food stall: one plain, one with a soft warm glow around the bare bulbs and the lit banner.
images.caption: Night Market 800 on a food stall at night, with halation off and at the recipe's 30. The glow appears only around the brightest parts: the bulbs and the edge of the lit banner. The picture is a generated one, not a photograph, cropped to the awning.
